finding: The scripted direct-pass fuse triggers the incoming warhead at its current position. Existing checks protected the AA platform/victim by30m and source by3m, but did not consider other nearby friendly/civilian/captive entities or larger configured blast ranges.
implementation: After confirmed same-owner direct-pass/arming geometry, read actual incoming CfgAmmo indirectHitRange/indirectHit/explosive. Reject malformed/negative/nonfinite metadata and unsupported radius>250m. Damaging/explosive warheads use the existing fire-safety policy max12m/four times indirectHitRange.

One current-position nearEntities sphere includes living infantry, land vehicles, aircraft, ships and occupants. More than64 results or any friendly/civilian/captive blocks the scripted fuse. Infantry uses underlying group side; other objects use native object side, which also classifies empty vehicles as civilian. No hull/obstruction damage guarantee.

Negative result is retained only at current engine time in the exact private episode, preventing other observed rounds in that sample repeating the query. No clearance result survives. Native firing/projectile flight remains unchanged.

Effect now refuses scheduled direct calls. Actual caller is CortexAAIntercept STEP queued through CortexQueueJob; its current-owner callback is unscheduled. No stale scheduled geometry is carried into triggerAmmo. No new timer/worker/network API or ownership transfer.
cost: One additional native radius query only after a real qualified pass and only for damaging/explosive warheads. At most64 candidates evaluated; denser results refuse after native discovery. Negative same-sample coalescing bounds repeated round effects. Native query cost and whole-mod overhead remain unmeasured.
limits: Scripted fuse approximation remains optional/default-off, same-owner and non-submunition only. No cross-owner effect or interception completion handover implemented.
Position/radius protection is conservative and not complete hull, wall, blast/fragment or civilian-identification modelling. Native impacts are not controlled by this veto.
Actual protected-unit/empty/mixed-crew aircraft/ship cases, successful interceptions, balance, normal/provider-HC and5%median/10%p95 overhead remain unverified. Audits paused.
